facts.did: 说 Wainscot 在练习厅与更进阶的学生在一起，自己想专注于 Gardenpath，并称 Gardenpath 比 Wainscot 有前途得多
facts.anchor: I wanted to devote my attention to you.

facts.did: 伸臂触碰 Gardenpath，灼烧感在其膜上扩散，并以痛苦撕裂的方式进入其体内
facts.anchor: A burning sensation diffused across Gardenpath’s membrane

facts.did: 在 Gardenpath 体内命令其展示触碰多细胞生物里 director cells 的经历，明确不要数据而要体验本身
facts.anchor: Show me what happened when you touched the director cells

facts.did: 闪避导师的抓取，让一个 gnosome 变通透，释放出与 Murtis 触碰手臂时被强制 clustering 的去语境化感受
facts.anchor: the decontextualized sensation of being forced to cluster

facts.did: 在 cluster bowl 崩溃成一滩并哭诉说 Plumline 的练习“感觉像被谋杀”
facts.anchor: But it hurts so much. It feels like being murdered.

facts.did: Gardenpath 提议告诉 Plumline 两人想一起备考 Third；Wainscot 附议可把它包装成一场竞赛
facts.anchor: we want to study for the Third together?

facts.did: 宣布两人的考试排在下次旅程的 Contribution 期间，要求把假设新鲜地编入 gnosomes 以便考官直接提取
facts.anchor: your exams on our next journey, during Contribution.

facts.did: 感谢 Gardenpath 想出办法避免与导师独处，随后害羞地伸出手臂，并私下说要想办法警告更年轻的学生
facts.anchor: thanked Gardenpath for coming up with a way

relations.relation: Plumline 是 Gardenpath 的导师（their adviser），两人单独在 Plumline 办公室
relations.anchor: at Plumline’s office, their adviser was alone

relations.relation: Wainscot 长期被 Plumline 强迫练习，直到 Gardenpath 出现；练习令其痛苦到像被谋杀
relations.anchor: They’ve been making me practice for a long time.

relations.relation: Gardenpath 爱着“与挚友共建生活”的念头；Oriel 是他们的 best friend
relations.anchor: building a life with their best friend

relations.relation: 两名 former enemies 结成同盟，用不太隐蔽的策略避免与 Plumline 独处
relations.anchor: the two former enemies had banded together

relations.relation: Oriel 评价 Plumline 的教学法：那是彻头彻尾的谎言，是虐待而非教学，必须告诉别人
relations.anchor: That is a complete lie. It’s abuse, not teaching.

numbers.fact: Plumline 说 Gardenpath 将成为五十代以来最伟大的学者
numbers.anchor: you will be the greatest scholar in fifty generations

numbers.fact: 有学生相信这位 investigator 是百代以来最伟大的科学家
numbers.anchor: the greatest scientist in a hundred generations

numbers.fact: 多名其他学生也突然提出用“竞争”模式备考 Third
Buttress 带着水汽抵达，宣布自己终于通过了 Second 考试
numbers.anchor: It finally happened! I passed the Second!
